chunks: Through boiling water, and then burnt in the Fire.

key_terms.الْحَمِيمِ: Boiling water or scalding fluid used as a punishment in Hell
key_terms.يُسْجَرُونَ: They are cast into or burnt in

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'al-hamim' and 'yusjarun' in the context of Hellfire punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the progressive intensification of punishment, where the initial torment of boiling water (al-hamim) serves as a precursor to the eternal burning in Hellfire (an-nar). This sequence underscores the divine justice that matches the degree of disbelief, a concept frequently elaborated upon by Imams such as Al-Baqir and Al-Sadiq to illustrate the physical and spiritual dimensions of retribution.
